converter.description: Inspect the exact resource, then prepare it. The processor resolves embedded/export metadata and exact-source resource_inputs.json settings. The host collects missing fields in chat for AI attachments, or the import dialog for file explorer imports; do not copy another source settings. CSV never silently assumes a format. RESOURCE_INPUTS.md documents project requirements.

source_format.description: Use motionstudio-g1 for a confirmed Motion Studio G1 export: XYZ metres, XYZW CSV / marked WXYZ NPZ, 29 G1 joints. The legacy motionstudio-g1-default alias identifies only the format, never coordinates or FPS. Resolve coordinates and FPS from matching metadata or user confirmation for this exact file; ask for missing facts.
